  • I've already walked you through the basics of how to manage your loadout in GTA 6, but here's a quick tip to help you get the most out of your best GTA 6 guns.
  • Most Ammu-Nation stores have a weapons locker – basically every location besides Pawn shop variants.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There will come a time during your adventures in GTA 6 that you own too many weapons. This sounds like a great problem to have, but the reality is that it can make swiftly equipping your favorite longarms and sidearms from the trunk of your vehicle a bit of a nightmare – particularly if you have the cops or gangs chasing you down.

I've already walked you through the basics of how to manage your loadout in GTA 6, but here's a quick tip to help you get the most out of your best GTA 6 guns.

Most Ammu-Nation stores have a weapons locker – basically every location besides Pawn shop variants. Approach the green locker, and you'll either press L1/LB to manage your loadout or Triangle/Y to manage your weapons.

Industry observers note that what you want to do here is click the 'Manage Weapons' option. This will let you see every weapon that you own, all of the Unique Weapon Variants that you have purchased/discovered, and plenty more besides – so long as it's a weapon that you own, this is where you can recover lost or destroyed guns.

The Ammu-Nation Weapons Locker is also where you can add guns to the trunk of your Personal Vehicle in GTA 6 – ensuring that you have fast and easy access to them while on the move. A good tip here is that you can press Square/X on every category of weapon to either add or remove it from your trunk. If there's a weapon you've unlocked but aren't otherwise interested in – remove it from your trunk in GTA 6 to ensure it isn't getting in the way of the weapons you do want access to.

According to recent reports, it's from this screen where you can also equip any Unique Weapon Variants. If you have one available for a particular weapon, you'll see a golden gun icon in the bottom left corner. Press Triangle/Y to access a sub-menu that will let you view and equip the variant, or select your own personally modified version of the weapon instead if you own the base version already.

Should you be in a hurry you can also directly equip sidearms, longarms, explosives, melee weapons, and other items from the Ammu-Nation weapons locker. Just be warned: the employees may not take kindly to seeing you brandish a rifle in their store, no matter how much money you just spent purchasing GTA 6 weapon mods.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Nioh 3 has received a hot new patch that brings plenty of bug fixes to very specific challenges, but it also implements fixes for a few of the most common - and incredibly annoying - bugs. Patch 1.03.01 arrived earlier on all platforms, and it comes with a chunky set of notes.

This latest revision, predictably, doesn’t add any gameplay features, but some of the included fixes will absolutely delight - or vindicate - so many of the game’s millions of players.

There’s plenty to go through in the patch notes published today for revision 1.03.01, but the most impactful is a fix for an problem that “sometimes made it impossible to use elixirs during battle.” This is only a partial fix, but if you ran into the problem of smashing that shortcut button and not seeing your character play the healing animation, you’ll be glad to see it.

Recent findings suggest that this is a problem myself and others have faced, especially in boss fights. You can even see the shortcut register your button press and proceed to ignore you. Another partial fix has been made to an glitch that caused the game to crash. Team Ninja didn’t share specifics on that, and though Nioh 3 has been fairly stable for me in 70+ hours, it has definitely crashed a few times.

If you’ve been playing since launch, you likely have - or know someone who has - run into problems with save file corruption and other weird bugs around certain trackable items within save files.

In a recent development, team Ninja already rolled out a couple of fixes there, and this latest one specifically targets losing valuables during Myths. If your save file has been affected, the game will now check and recover what was lost. Even more interesting is that the game will now automatically create a backup copy of your save data any time you load a save.

If you’ve made it into the Eternal Rift, you’ll be happy to know that today’s enhancement takes care of a few progression blockers, and fixes an concern that allowed some players to obtain certain items before they were supposed to, locking themselves out.

One of the more amusing fixes concerns Mujina, who had a tendency to respawn if you prayed at a Shrine after opening a chest it was hiding in, which made it appear far more often than a mimic should.

Finally, there’s a set of fixes that address bugs (and exploits) when using specific Martial Art with certain weapons. There are a few fixes to AI, Myths, and one problem with the Minamoto no Yoritomo boss fight that made it impossible to interrupt him, even after he runs out of Ki.

It has been revealed that hit the link at the top for the full change log, and check out our Nioh 3 gameplay tips if you haven’t already. You should also change these settings ASAP, as they’re going to make your life much easier and save you a lot of time.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • The folks behind Nexus Mods have rolled out a fresh "daily limit" system which ensures modders who upload multiple works in bulk during a single 24 hour period can't take up more than one spot in the tabs dedicated to showing off new mods for different games.
  • Recent findings suggest that "Nexus Mods owner and CEO Victor 'Foledinho' Folmann hinted measures related to making the glut of newly introduced mods at the moment uploaded on a daily basis less of a discovery nightmare in last week's announcement post about the site's current policy regarding the use of genAI in mod making.
  • Industry observers note that cue an an announcement on Nexus Mods' Discord server yesterday by community manager Phoenix introducing the latest "daily limit", which Nexus were keen to emphasise is "an experiment" they're open to feedback on.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The folks behind Nexus Mods have rolled out a fresh "daily limit" system which ensures modders who upload multiple works in bulk during a single 24 hour period can't take up more than one spot in the tabs dedicated to showing off new mods for different games. Instead, those who chuck up their mods in bulk will see one of their works given a spot, while the rest are neatly filed away behind it, ready to spring out if you click a bit of text indicating that modder's got other fresh works to show off.

Recent findings suggest that "Nexus Mods owner and CEO Victor 'Foledinho' Folmann hinted measures related to making the glut of newly introduced mods at the moment uploaded on a daily basis less of a discovery nightmare in last week's announcement post about the site's current policy regarding the use of genAI in mod making. "We’ve received feedback regarding authors uploading numerous mods at once and overwhelming the Recently Added section, pushing everyone else down the page," he wrote. "This is less of an issue related to AI, but it’s becoming much more prevalent as mod production is speeding up. Thus, we’re trying out limits on the number of mods from one author that can be shown in this section to give others a better chance of getting noticed. We’re also putting tighter restrictions on uploads from newly created accounts. The first of these updates will be available soon.".

Industry observers note that cue an an announcement on Nexus Mods' Discord server yesterday by community manager Phoenix introducing the latest "daily limit", which Nexus were keen to emphasise is "an experiment" they're open to feedback on. "We know that time in the New Mods view is vital for a new mod to be discovered and we believe every mod author should have equal chances of having their work seen," they wrote. "While we're working on more sophisticated tools to give you control over the mods displayed to you, we are testing a stopgap solution that we hope will address the issue for now: For the time being, the New Mods view will display one mod per mod author. This limit refreshes every twenty-four hours – so if you publish one mod every day, you won't be affected.".

Recent findings suggest that the All Mods, Updated, Trending, Popular, and Surprise tabs for games are unaffected by the change, so will still dedicate a tab to each work regardless of who uploaded it when. If you take a glance at the Fresh Mods pages for the likes of Skyrim, Fallout 4, and Cyberpunk 2077 this morning, you can already see the new mod stacking in action. The most mods from the same author I've seen stacked atop each other so far is 14 Fallout 4 works piled up.

It's worth noting you can also toggle the show only one newly introduced mod per modder rule off in the new mods tab, bringing back the older layout with one slot per mod regardless of uploader.

Personally, I tend to sort by mods with the most endorsements or downloads within the past 24 hours or seven days when I'm scanning for newly introduced mods, rather than just scrolling back through the new mods tab. Though I appreciate that could mean I've been missing out on some stellar works by lesser known modders whose creations never get the traction they merit thanks to being buried under an avalanche of other works. If so, hopefully this enhancement does help the lone mods avoid being run over by mass upload freight trains.

  • The big new arrival is Varka, who joins as a playable character for the first time.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, the latest big content upgrade has been revealed for HoYoverse's breakout game, Genshin Impact. Version Luna 5, which has the unusually long and needlessly layered title — Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation - Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind — is set to arrive February 25.

In a recent development, this one is a bit of a nostalgia play, taking everyone back to Mondstadt, the place where you may remember taking your first steps. And, as with any good return to the ol’ hunting grounds, come familiar characters, too.

The big new arrival is Varka, who joins as a playable character for the first time. Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, is a character whose debut has been long-awaited. He is a 5-Star Anemo Claymore wielder with a dual-wield combat style, capable of dealing two different types of Elemental damage. His addition means that there's now finally a burly 5-Star male character of each elemental type... do with that information what you will.

Varka's dual-wielding combat style allows him to deal two different types of Elemental damage at the same time. The way it works is that his Elemental Skill boosts the damage of his regular attacks, but it also converts the damage type of his right-hand claymore to match his teammates’ elements (Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo). The left-hand claymore always deals Anemo damage.

The more normal attacks you use, the more frequently he can activate a special Elemental Skill, or trigger a Charged Attack that doesn’t consume stamina. He can also rely on the Hexerei effect to trigger more instances of Elemental Skill, as well as Charged Attacks, making him a monster damage-dealer.

According to recent reports, varka, of course, has been a staple member of the cast, featuring in both the original story in a small cameo, as well as taking a bigger role in the recent Nod-Krai chapters. With the return to Mondstadt, his playable debut makes sense. His Story Quest will shed light on his encounter with the Wild Hunt, and the Great Wolf King of the North.

Industry observers note that the reruns for this version are going to be Flins — who will be available in the first phase of Event Wishes — as well as Skirk and Escoffier in the second phase. You can also look forward to the return of the Chronicled Wish with Mondstadt characters.

Staying on the theme of reminiscence, the big event in Luna 5 is centered around revisiting memories from the beginning of your time with Genshin Impact, and reuniting with old friends. In Echoes of Memory, you’ll witness familiar scenes that have been changed slightly, and you’ll need to use the Spotter Kamera to detect and record those differences.

The Knights of Favonius are hosting several other activities for everyone to take part in, including an event that lets you catch up with old friends over drinks which you make for them.

Industry observers note that outside of events, there’s a new set of Gliding and Combat Challenges. And, of course, there are new minigames that you can relax with. The Kamera is being utilised yet again, and this time you can use to capture sights from your time in spots across Natlan, Fontaine, and Sumeru. There’s also… a horde mode of a sort, where you fend off waves of enemies.

Catch up on the latest set of Genshin Impact codes before you play, and check out why we think Genshin Impact is one of the best mobile games you can play today.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Surprisingly, Atlantis wasn't left out.

Grand Theft Auto VI is out today, so a fair few people are going to disappear into Leonida for the foreseeable future. If you’re not one of them, the latest expansion for Disney Dreamlight Valley is also here, and after Gameloft’s near 30-minute showcase back in October, you can now actually play The Keepsake Sea.

You can swim beneath the waves in a latest Merfolk form, which comes with a wide range of customisation and colour options, and Dory from Finding Nemo joins you down there as the first Adventure Companion. She’ll help you uncover hidden items and hand out rewards of her own as well. That is, if she remembers.

Sources indicate that the latest story is spread across three mysterious island Biomes, each with its own environments and underwater areas to explore. Five new Villagers come along with it. Captain Jack Sparrow is the obvious name, but you’re also getting Captain Hook and Wendy from Peter Pan, Megara from Hercules and Milo Thatch from Atlantis: The Lost Empire.

Further into the story, you’ll unlock your own Enchanted Pirate Ship, which you can customise and sail around The Keepsake Sea with a crew of Villagers on board. There are new Character Houses and Decoration Blueprints too, plus more decorative items, as always.

On Apple Arcade, the expansion comes with your subscription at no extra cost, as the earlier ones did. Three paid expansions in, I think that makes Arcade the easiest way into the Valley by some distance. The catch is that there’s no Star Path or Premium Shop in the Arcade Edition, and your save won’t move outside Apple’s own devices, so anyone with a well-established Valley on Switch would be starting from scratch.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that some of Pokemon’s most popular (and most expensive) plushes are its life-size ones. Plush replicas of Pokemon designed to match the exact specifications in the games. They usually cost a lot of money, but sell out pretty fast, which is why a lot of Pokemon fans are going to be left disappointed by the latest life-size reveal.

The latest Pokemon to be getting the life-size treatment is Riolu. If its dimensions are accurate, which they should be as that’s the entire point of these plushes, then the latest Riolu toy will be a little over two feet tall. Not one of Pokemon’s bigger life-size plushes, but that means it will cost quite a bit less.

That’s the good news. The bad news is that, for some reason, according to Pokejungle, the Riolu plush is only going to be available in China. Exclusive to the Pokemon Center website in China and releasing on November 20, with no indication of it being available elsewhere, not even in Pokemon’s home country of Japan.

In a recent development, this is the part where I reassure you that the plush will eventually be released elsewhere, or, at worst, there are ways to get the plush shipped to you if you’re willing to pay significantly extra. That’s what usually happens when Pokemon merch is released in Japan before getting a worldwide rollout. In China, that doesn’t tend to be the case.

In a recent development, in 2025, life-size plushes of Ekans and Serperior were released in China to celebrate the Year of the Snake. As far as I can tell, those plushes have never been made available anywhere else. While still frustrating, at least in that instance the plushes were tied to a Chinese tradition. We are presently in the Year of the Horse and a few months out from the Year of the Goat. I’m fairly certain Riolu is neither of those.

Riolu is a dog Pokemon. The next Year of the Dog isn't until 2030.

Recent findings suggest that there is hope for those of you with the life-size Lucario (that got a worldwide release) in need of its pre-evolved buddy. Razer’s Gengar collection was originally exclusive to China, and although it took a while, it was eventually made available worldwide. Make enough noise, and perhaps The Pokemon Firm will do the same and eventually free Riolu from its region-locked prison.

  • According to recent reports, to check your investment in BuckMe Family Savings, press Up on the D-pad to pull out your phone and then head into the BuckMe app.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that one of the more interesting ideas that Rockstar Games has introduced this time around is the ability to save money for your family's future in GTA 6. This is an ever-present objective throughout the game and completely optional, but you're no doubt wondering if it's truly worth it.

In a recent development, let's step back for a second and talk about managing your money in GTA 6. Once you have unlocked your BuckMe online banking account in Chapter 1, you'll have the option to put money away in your BuckMe Family Savings. This is a joint account shared by Jason and Lucia, with either character able to deposit money into the pool – however, the money can never be withdrawn or spent.

According to recent reports, to check your investment in BuckMe Family Savings, press Up on the D-pad to pull out your phone and then head into the BuckMe app. Click the option for family saving and you'll see how much has been invested. There are five tiers of balance limit, and this will increase as you progress through the main GTA 6 missions. If you hit a target threshold before the balance limit increases, BuckMe will give you a big interest boost to help reach the next goal a little faster.

Press Up on the D-pad to pull out your phone and then head into the BuckMe app. Click the Family Saving option and then click the 'Buck Yourself' button, which will let either Jason or Lucia invest whatever amount of funds from their respective BuckMe Checking Accounts that they want to. Just remember, when money is invested in savings it can not be removed or spent.

It has been revealed that whether you want to put money into the BuckMe Saving Account to save for your family's future in GTA 6 is completely up-to-you. It is the only 100% way to secure your money in the game, but the funds also can't be spent or withdrawn by Jason and Lucia. Think about the sort of characters you want to role-play in Leonida, your GTA 6 Criminal Profile and your GTA 6 Relationship Status, and how invested you are in the story. The status of your saving account will impact certain interactions between the characters, and influence the ending you'll encounter, but to say anything more would be a spoiler.

  • In a recent development, unfortunately, some of the later cars won’t give you this option because they are keyless.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that this wouldn’t be a Grand Theft Auto game without a little bit of … well, Grand Theft Auto. One of the first things you will likely be encouraged to do in Grand Theft Auto 6 is steal a car, and for the most part, it can be relatively easy to do. Break a window and hotwire it. Nothing more to it. Unfortunately, later in the game, especially in higher end neighborhoods, there will be vehicles with electric locks that require a bit of finesse to ensure the alarm doesn’t go off.

According to recent reports, at the beginning of the game, Jason will only have the ability to smash open a window to unlock the car’s door. This is something that has been apart of the series since its creation. In chapter 2, Lucia will learn how to Slim Jim a car to ensure that the alarm system won’t go off and you’ll have a cleaner getaway.

In a recent development, unfortunately, some of the later cars won’t give you this option because they are keyless. This is what a key cloner is for. This will allow you to essentially hack into a car’s system and not only open the door but hotwire it in the process.

Sources indicate that unfortunately, early in the story you won’t be able to clone keys. You will have your trusty elbow and Slim Jim for the first two chapters, but once you hit Chapter 3, things change a little bit.

You will meet a man by the name of Randy. He is a car dealer who deals in hot cars (stolen) and has employed both Lucia and Jason to get him some of the fastest and most expensive cars possible. Don’t worry about smashing them up; so long as they can pull into his garage, he can fix it.

You will get a mission from Randy where he will want a Zorrusso located all the way Vice Beach (east). Head down and start this mission and Randy will call you to explain the situation.

Industry observers note that by starting this mission, you will unlock the key cloner app on your phone, allowing you to finally be able to unlock some of the higher-grade vehicles. Be cautious, though, as cars that require a key cloner generally come with at least a standard tracker, which can alert police to your location if you’re not driving fast enough.

According to recent reports, regardless, after completing this mission, the car world is your oyster. Go out and have some fun.

In a recent development, A little over a month following the huge, vile, culture-defining (negative) merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. into Skydance, the corporation has confirmed that games division Skydance Games will be facing a round of layoffs, according to a report from Variety.

Industry observers note that skydance Games was born from combining Paramount and Warner Bros' own individual divisions, bringing developers like NetherRealm, Rocksteady, WB Games Montreal/Boston, TT Games and Avalanche under the same umbrella as Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra developers and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin publishers Paramount Games Studio. All this was was done, of course, to maximise the amount of IP that the corporation can access to base games on, such as Avatar: The Last Airbender, Game of Thrones, Star Trek, the DC Universe, Harry Potter, and more. Skydance Games came into existence on October 6th; it barely lasted a month as it was.

In a statement given to Variety, Skydance confirmed that "As part of our ongoing efforts to position Skydance Games for long-term growth and success, we are implementing reorganization and operational shifts across a few areas of our business. We have stepped back and taken some time to consider where we are investing our efforts and have made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects. As a result, there are roles impacted. This is not a reflection of the talent, dedication, or creativity of those affected and we are grateful for their contributions. We are committed to approaching the process with transparency, care and respect for those who are leaving the manufacturer." Skydance did not disclose the number of staff affected.

Skydance joins the ever-growing list of corporations that have mandated layoffs in the recent past, such as Microsoft, Ubisoft, and EA. Workers will bleed until there is no one left to cut. Solidarity to all affected.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, even before the game came out, it was pretty easy to guess that Nioh 3 would be a hit. From the word of mouth leading up to launch, to the well-received free demo, there was little chance the action RPG wasn’t going to be a major deal.

According to recent reports, today, publisher Koei Tecmo has declared that the game has officially passed over one million copies sold worldwide across PC, and PlayStation 5. This makes it the fastest in the Nioh franchise to reach this milestone.

As a result of this fantastic launch, Nioh 3 has now pushed overall Nioh franchise sales to be over 10 million, which includes the original Nioh as well as Nioh 2. Today’s news comes just two weeks after the game arrived on PC, and PS5.

On Steam, where it’s available on PC, it shot up the Steam charts, and immediately broke the series’ previous best peak concurrent player count record. From there, the numbers kept growing, leading up to a stellar weekend where it peaked at 88,045 concurrent players on Steam, double that of its launch day.

This now stands as the largest for any Nioh game on Steam, and though we don’t have insight into how well it’s doing on PS5 specifically, it still reveals that the Nioh series continues to grow.

Nioh 3 builds on everything the two prior games established, and pushes the series into the semi-open-world realm, with several larger maps that each cover a period of time in Japan’s history. In our Nioh 3 review we called it “Team Ninja’s most accomplished action game, and the series’ most accessible.”.

If you’re curious about the challenging and very rewarding action RPG, start with these gameplay tips, and don’t be shy to call upon a friend (or stranger) for help using our co-op guide.

GTA 6 weapon ownership explained: How to keep your favorite guns

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (630 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gamesradar

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that found a cool gun in GTA 6 and want to keep a hold of it for future criminal activities?
  • There are both owned and unowned weapons, and understanding the difference can help ease some frustration the next time you go to manage your loadout in GTA 6 and find that the awesome assault rifle you had a few hours ago has gone missing.
  • Industry observers note that owned weapons must be either purchased from Ammu-Nation stores located all across Leonida or be otherwise gifted to you by a character in one of the GTA 6 Missions.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that found a cool gun in GTA 6 and want to keep a hold of it for future criminal activities? Then you're going to need to know how weapon ownership works. Just because you came across a firearm in your travels, doesn't mean that you can keep it forever.

There are both owned and unowned weapons, and understanding the difference can help ease some frustration the next time you go to manage your loadout in GTA 6 and find that the awesome assault rifle you had a few hours ago has gone missing.

Industry observers note that owned weapons must be either purchased from Ammu-Nation stores located all across Leonida or be otherwise gifted to you by a character in one of the GTA 6 Missions. Buying a weapon with Pocket Cash or your BuckMe account will give a copy of it to both Jason and Lucia, regardless of which character made the original purchase. However, the weapons must be modified and equipped independently.

If you drop a weapon (a good thing to do while trying to shake your GTA 6 Wanted Level) then they can always be recovered from the trunk of your personal vehicle or from a weapons locker located at most Ammu-Nation stores around Leonida.

Recent findings suggest that unowned Weapons function a little differently. This classification counts for any weapons that are dropped by enemies or located in the world ambiently (with one exception which I'll get to in a moment). These guns and melee weapons can't be recovered if they are lost, nor can they be owned for long-periods of time or modified at Ammu-Nation stores. If you find yourself Wasted or Busted, they will also be lost forever.

Industry observers note that the exception here are Unique Weapon Variants, which can be discovered as you explore a certain location (look for a golden gun icon on the minimap to help pinpoint these, typically found at special spots and illegal operation hideouts). While a Unique Weapon Variant in GTA 6 can't be modified, once they have been acquired they are permanently unlocked for both Jason and Lucia regardless of whether you've already purchased the base weapon. You can learn how to store, recover, and equip newly introduced weapons to your GTA 6 loadout here.

It has been revealed that most Ammu-Nation stores will only carry a small selection of firearms at the beginning of the game. But the more you invest in upcoming weapons, the faster key locations will begin to expand their stock. Over time, based on the number of weapons you purchase globally, you'll find that more guns will become available for purchase.   • The effort required to fix them is what led developer Maxis to make a commitment to improve the game’s technical state, and the developer has now returned to update the community on what to expect in 2026.
  • It has been revealed that the quality of life pledge was made in September last year, through the introduction of a roadmap.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that as the The Sims 4 continues into its second decade, the volume of fresh content, major expansions, and long-awaited features has grown in lockstep. Unfortunately, that has also meant that, given how old the game is, a few technical problems remain a nuisance.

The effort required to fix them is what led developer Maxis to make a commitment to improve the game’s technical state, and the developer has now returned to update the community on what to expect in 2026.

It has been revealed that the quality of life pledge was made in September last year, through the introduction of a roadmap. Since then, the developer issued one enhancement on its progress. Which brings us to this week’s new blog post, which further builds on everything that’s come before.

In the post, Maxis revealed a few key areas it’s going to be focusing on going forward. Though specific release dates for these changes were not shared, the list of issues should resonate with many players, as it covers many often-discussed topics.

Sources indicate that the first stage of the newly introduced roadmap covers March through August. Over that period, you can expect Sims' autonomy to improve. This goes for things like how they choose locations for certain actions, they way they interact with certain objects, and even how often they interrupt conversations.

The infant and caregiver relationship is being updated, too, in order to improve autonomy and make sure your little Sims don’t miss out on milestones and interactions. That stage of the roadmap also includes fixes for black photo challenges, and other crashes and freezing.

The next period takes place September through December, and it includes more interesting changes. One of the goals with this one is to improve Sims’ dining experience, which covers challenges around eating and drinking.

Another important area of focus with this stage is family trees, and relationships between members of the same family. Maxis wants to improve the game’s genealogy systems to make relationship tracking across generations more robust so that your family history isn’t lost.

Depending on how the first stage goes, you might see more concerns join the list of what the developer is looking at for the second stage of the roadmap.

Recent findings suggest that the good news is that you won’t have to wait too long for the game’s next patch. Due out in March, this next update will feature around 55 fixes, including for some commonly reported issues.

Recent findings suggest that until then, you may want to check out The Sims 4’s Lost Legacies Event, which is available now until the middle of March. If you picked up the game’s latest expansion, check if you tried those Royalty & Legacy cheats.

  • Sources indicate that it's a complete roll of the dice...

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Players are opening an ungodly number of chests in Fortnite in the hopes of winning big with Pirate Shop Access tokens, which make everything in the Item Shop completely free for two weeks—once in 2026, and once in 2027.

Sources indicate that it's a complete roll of the dice... if the dice had 137,500 sides. But there is a way to make the grind a little less tedious. As reported by Fortnite Leaks, you can now get the token and all other rewards in Respawn Rumble.

In a recent development, it's unclear if this is intentional, so it may be patched out soon, but the reason the community is celebrating and jumping headfirst into the mode is because you respawn infinitely, allowing you to open chests again and again and again without worry. That means you can retreat into the zone and stomach the damage for even more loot.

There are no special animations, and there's a bug where rewards are displayed with a grey chest icon and the text 'PH' (placeholder), but once you return to the lobby, you'll see what exactly the reward was.

According to recent reports, while this does make farming chests a lot easier, as you no longer need to worry about dying, there is a slight catch. One of the big benefits of playing Respawn Rumble is that you can have a squad of up to eight players, in theory increasing your odds even further when opening chests. Typically, if one person in your squad gets a reward, everyone does. Not in Respawn Rumble.

Sources indicate that according to Twitter user @SoundOriented, "you *ONLY* get the treasure for your Respawn Rumble fills in YOUR squad. The other 4 people do NOT get the reward." In so many words, only members of the predetermined lobby squad get the rewards, meaning that your odds aren't strictly better than in standard battle royale. Still, pilfering through chests at a rapid pace means rolling the dice a whole lot more than you otherwise could.

Recent findings suggest that it should be stated, since there's a lot of confusion about how RNG works, that the token isn't guaranteed if you open 137,500 chests. Imagine trying to guess a random number between 1 and 137,500, but every time you make another guess, the other person has changed the number they're thinking of. So, while you can open a lot more chests through Respawn Rumble, that doesn't mean there's an invisible tracker bringing you closer and closer to finding the Pirate Shop Access.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that grand Theft Auto 6 isn’t just about … well, Grand Theft Auto, but instead, you’ll be stealing anything and everything you get your hands on. To do this, though, you’ll need access to certain facilities and compounds. There are houses and buildings that can net you a nice profit, let alone be able to get into the back door of a bank and sneak your way into their vault. To do this, though, you’ll need a special item called a Snap Gun.

According to recent reports, the Snap Gun is Grand Theft Auto’s handy little tool that’s similar to a lockpick. Why Jason and Lucia can’t just pick a lock is beyond me, but this item’s main purpose is to ensure that the two have a quick and painless time getting into doors.

Sources indicate that this will only work on doors, so garages will need a different tool, but suffice to say, this becomes one of the most crucial tools in your arsenal simply because it ensures that you won’t trip an alarm when entering. Normally, you’d have to force your way into a locked door, but this bypasses that entirely.

In the third chapter of the campaign, you will have a couple of heists that you can do for Yasmani, someone who fleeces your marked bills (and narcotics but at a much lower than Tyronne). There will be three of these jewelry stores you’ll be able to take down, but really, you only need one for this trick.

It is very notable that you prioritize at least one of these “missions” as it will help you get the Snap Gun very quickly, and considering its importance in staying undetected, it comes in handy early on.

Head to one of the shops on the map and rob it blind. It doesn’t matter if you play it smoothly or go loud, so long as you get into the safe from the code Yasmani gave you, you will be in the clear.

Sources indicate that after robbing the first one, return to Yasmani to get your take on the haul. He will give you your cut for the job but will give you something in return: The Snap Gun. It’s just that easy. Do one of the jobs requiring a safe for Yasmani, and you’ll be able to break into houses and locked doors with ease.

All you need to do is find the right pressure point on the left stick and then spam the RT/R2 button until it’s open.

Sources indicate that EDward Gaming have lost captain nobody and CHICHOO, two days after releasing Smoggy to Bilibili Gaming. The VCT China partner team must now rebuild before the China Kickoff in Hangzhou in January.

EDward Gaming have parted ways with CHICHOO and captain nobody, two pillars of the side that won VALORANT Champions 2024. Both players left the VCT China partner team on the same day. EDG revealed both exits on Weibo. Their exits end a five-year spell at the organisation.

The departures follow rapidly on from Smoggy’s move to Bilibili Gaming. Within a week, three players had gone from the EDG roster. No replacements have been named.

Wang ‘nobody’ Senxu joined EDG on 7 September 2021. He served as the team’s captain and in-game leader. He had started out as the side’s Initiator before taking on those leadership duties. CHICHOO, whose full name is Wan Shunzhi, played the Controller role. Alongside CHICHOO, he formed the core of the only Chinese team to win Champions. That title, sealed on 25 August 2024, made EDG the first organisation from China, and from Asia, to lift the trophy. The team’s total winnings stand at roughly $1,592,287.

The pair were still central to the side in 2026. At Masters London, CHICHOO and nobody each played 12 maps. Their average combat scores were 179 and 184 respectively. EDG finished third in London and earned $125,000. Their run ended with a 0-3 defeat to Leviatán in the lower bracket final on 20 June 2026.

Sources indicate that where nobody goes next is not yet confirmed. Sheep Esports reported, citing sources, that he is expected to join Trace Esports for 2027. Trace’s Kai and deLb are noted to be under contract until the end of 2027. If that move happens, nobody and Smoggy would both start the newly introduced season with different organisations.

In a recent development, the timing is awkward for EDG. The organisation was named a VCT partner team on 21 October, on a two-year contract. That deal now begins with a heavily changed roster.

The China Kickoff is an S-Tier LAN event. It is organised by TJ Sports, Hero Esports and Riot Games. The league’s partner sides make up eight places in the field, with the remaining four split evenly between visiting teams and open qualifier entrants. EDG will need a settled line-up in place to compete there.

General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Rockpapershotgun ↗ Open Full Page

Steam's newly introduced Steam Deck framerate graphs are good news for handheld players, though I wouldn't fully trust the numbers yet

📅 10 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (450 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Rockpapershotgun

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that valve have finally made clear what they've been doing with all that hoovered-up performance data and all those "Framerate Estimator" text strings: a framerate estimator for the Steam Deck.
  • In a recent development, the thinking, as Valve explain in a Steam post, is to set more precise performance expectations than the existing verification ratings – Verified, Playable, and Unsupported – provide.
  • By Valve's own admission, the displayed results may be skewed by V-Sync treachery, where this anti-screen tear setting (which many games enable by default) could force games into briefly running at unrepresentative framerates.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that valve have finally made clear what they've been doing with all that hoovered-up performance data and all those "Framerate Estimator" text strings: a framerate estimator for the Steam Deck. Or, rather, a framerate average-r, as games on the Steam Store are now getting attached graphs – under their existing Steam Deck Compatibility details – that show how many frames-per-secondseses that game has been recording on real players' handhelds, the OLED and original LCD models both.

In a recent development, the thinking, as Valve explain in a Steam post, is to set more precise performance expectations than the existing verification ratings – Verified, Playable, and Unsupported – provide. This may induce some gentle learned nodding, if you've ever tried an Unsupported game only to find it works more or less fine, or have ever wondered why a game that can just about scrape 30fps together gets the same green good-job sticker as something that screams along at 90fps. Now, when checking that rating, you'll also get a relatively specific idea of smoothness and/or chugging potential.

Or will you? By Valve's own admission, the displayed results may be skewed by V-Sync treachery, where this anti-screen tear setting (which many games enable by default) could force games into briefly running at unrepresentative framerates. The scoundrel. My current handheld game beau, Mortal Shell II, looks like it may be falling victim to this: its results for the LCD Steam Deck show it mostly runs around 30fps, which is in line with my experience, but the OLED results show it averaging around 45fps. The Steam Deck OLED's APU is a tiny bit quicker than the LCD Deck's, but it's not that much of an upgrade.

There's work to be done, then, though I do appreciate the concept. As tightly as I cling to my battery-efficient, mercifully Windows-free Deck OLED in the face of drastically more powerful handhelds, with every year it becomes a little less likely that fresh games will comfortably run on it. Verification ratings can still act as decent (if broad) guidelines, but even with V-Sync putting an immaculately untorn thumb on the scales, game-specific framerate data will be much more illustrative.

As for whether these histograms will also get Steam Machine versions, or perhaps cover non-Valve handhelds, Valve say this: "We see this patch as a stepping stone toward providing framerate data for more devices than just Steam Deck. To this end, we are also prompting customers to opt-in to providing anonymized framerate data in the Steam desktop client. This opt-in is presently only on Steam Client Beta, and will ship to all customers in the future." So, maybe, if you gizzus yer data.

💡 Key Takeaways

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Version Luna 5 of Genshin Impact is now live, but it's a bittersweet occasion for fans of HoYoverse's breakout gacha RPG – at the very least, those who are still playing the game on PlayStation 4, which is presumably true of somebody out there.

Industry observers note that hoYoverse announced last year that they intended to wind down support for Genshin Impact on PS4, which – alongside PC, Android, and iOS – was one of the launch platforms for the game back in 2020. And with Version Luna 5, those end days are upon us.

The game has already been delisted on the platform since last September, meaning it was no longer available for download and could only be updated by players who already had it installed. But as of today, paid purchases from the in-game store have been disabled on PS4; and in six weeks' time, on approximately April 8, Version Luna 6 will discontinue access to the PS4 version altogether.

In many ways this is unsurprising – Genshin is already available on both PS5 and Xbox Series to sate fans eager to play on console, and the PS4's hardware is increasingly struggling to keep up with this massive open-world game after more than five years of regular updates have ballooned both its file size and technical requirements.

Aptly enough, Luna 5 takes the main story action back to the nation of Mondstadt, the location where the Traveler (and, by extension, the players) took their first steps into the world of Teyvat back in September 2020. It feels like a symbolic last hurrah for the original console home of the game, as does the inclusion of a Chronicled Wish banner focussing on some of Mondstadt's most iconic (read: too old to be meta by now) 5-Star characters – namely Eula, Mona, Albedo, Klee, Diluc, and Jean.

And as the icing on the Tea Break Pancake, this banner is running alongside the long-anticipated introduction of Varka – the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius who has been a major character in the game's lore from the very beginning, but who only became playable with today's upgrade.

Looking ahead to that post-Luna 6 future, Genshin Impact will still be available on PS5, as well as Xbox Series consoles, PC, and mobile devices – so hopefully anyone who is still playing primarily on PS4 will find another platform they can continue the adventure on by April.

Fresh mobile picks you should give a go this week.

Who doesn't love upcoming games? We certainly do - there's just something about the exhilaration of a new title you can't wait to dive into, as the loading screen pops up and you enter a brave new world.

Of course, newly introduced mobile games are a dime a dozen these days, and who has the time to scour the iPhone, iPad and/or Android stores to catch the latest title that drops? Fret not - we've gathered a quick list of 5 new mobile games you should try this week, whether that's an undiscovered indie gem or a high-profile AAA masterpiece.

That remarked, you can head on over to our NEW WEEKLY MOBILE GAMES hub if you're on the hunt for more curated adventures to obsess over!

For me, management sims always have that inevitable level of stress that just gets worse and worse as you progress. Thrifty Business, however, seems to subvert all that, as while you're tasked with managing your own thrift shop, it supposedly does so in a totally chill, totally low-pressure way.

That alone is enough to pique my interest, to be honest, but couple that with its charming visuals and 90s-inspired aesthetics and I'm sold. The sim lets you unlock furniture and decor as you go along, with over 500 cosmetic items you can tinker around with - and the best part of it all is that the first 60 minutes are free for you to try!

According to recent reports, download now! Thrifty Business.

Recent findings suggest that my little 12-year-old niece is, I feel, the smartest kid in the world, but even she's not capable of throwing people to the dungeons to keep her kingdom's affairs in order. In Lil' Guardsman, the eponymous Lil is tasked with exactly that, as she's left on gate guard duty by her dear ol' dad. What's doubly more adorable here is that she'll have to deal with all manner of creatures from goblins to elves, and even might have to deal with - god forbid - humans!

Sources indicate that it's essentially a border control sim, but with fantasy shenanigans you'll need to investigate throughout your shift. There are more than a hundred different characters whose fates you'll tangle and untangle, so you'd best get your deduction skills on point.

We've got another roguelike in our list this week, and I'm not complaining! Rogue Adventure is a dungeon-crawling RPG with procedurally generated elements where you combine cards and unleash epic skills onto unwitting foes to win.

The turn-based deck-builder features over 15 different classes you can experiment with across four modes, and if you're feeling a little competitive, you can even duke it out with other players in tournaments that refresh every week. The many, many card combos take centre stage here, of course, so suffice it to say you're spoilt for choice.

In a recent development, with the PUBG live-action adaptation having just been confirmed, everyone's probably looking for ways to dive into the battle royale either as a complete newbie or as a returning veteran just to refresh their shooting skills. Which is why I think PUBG Mobile Flash comes at just the right time, offering all of us a lightweight alternative to dominating Erangel.

The keyword here is "lightweight", with a smaller download size of under 0.96 GB on Android (that's under 1.75 GB on iOS). It's no secret that games are getting heftier and heftier these days, so having something like this in your back pocket with the same optimised experience is definitely a godsend. You can choose what you download, so the maps and modes are available on an "as needed" basis.

It has been revealed that download now! PUBG Mobile Flash.

Bart Bonte is at it again with his series of colour-themed puzzlers, and this time, it's Brown that's taking the spotlight.

Sources indicate that at its core, Bonte's puzzles are all about filling the entire screen with whatever colour's in the title, so for this one, you'll need to do just that across 50 levels. Some puzzles are a simple matter of putting two and two together, while others need a little bit more logic to figure out - thankfully, there's a handy hint system to help you out in case you ever get stuck!

How to manage money in GTA 6 and use the BuckMe bank savings app

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Money in GTA 6 works a little differently compared to previous games in the series.
  • Recent findings suggest that the GTA 6 money management system is split into three key areas: Pocket Cash, BuckMe Checking Account, and BuckMe Family Savings.
  • Recent findings suggest that pocket Cash is physical money, the hard cash often earned through burglaries and robberies.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Money in GTA 6 works a little differently compared to previous games in the series. With Jason and Lucia on the run in Leonida, fighting to build themselves a better life, resources can be stretched pretty thin. That's why it's really vital that you understand how money works in GTA 6 and the different ways to manage your cash reserves.

Recent findings suggest that the GTA 6 money management system is split into three key areas: Pocket Cash, BuckMe Checking Account, and BuckMe Family Savings. Below I'm going to lay out everything you need to know about all three, and flag some of the ways you can make your cash go a little further.

Recent findings suggest that pocket Cash is physical money, the hard cash often earned through burglaries and robberies. Both Jason and Lucia can individually carry up to $20,000 in pocket cash.

This currency is accepted by most businesses for smaller purchases up to $1000 (you can locate these stores within the GTA 6 index). For more expensive purchases (or for services which only work with digital currencies), you'll need to use your BuckMe Checking Account.

Industry observers note that tip: All of your Pocket Cash will be lost if you are Wasted or Busted. If you're carrying a lot of cash on you, consider learning how to use ATMs in GTA 6.

It has been revealed that during Chapter 1, you'll unlock access to a BuckMe Checking Account as part of the main story. This is an online banking app which can be used to manage and save your money, and is used to handle any and all purchases over $1000. You can access the BuckMe application at any time in free-roam by pressing Up on the D-Pad to pull out your phone. Once the app is open, you can view transactions and make payments.

While Jason and Lucia have their own individual BuckMe Checking Accounts (and pools of cash to draw from as a result) both characters' balance limits will increase over time as you progress through the story. Upgraded accounts also offer special perks and lower fees, and you'll receive an in-game notification via the app in Chapter 2, Chapter 3, and Chapter 4 to flag when the relevant GTA 6 mission has been completed to allow for an upgrade.

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more.

Tip: If you ever do hit your BuckMe Checking Account balance limit, you won't be able to receive any additional payments – all incoming transactions will be pending until there's space for a full deposit.

In a recent development, GTA 6 gives you the option to save for the future of your family. This will unlock during Chapter 1 as part of the main story, and the amount of money that you can invest in your future will upgrade in Chapter 2, Chapter 3, and Chapter 4. So long as you haven't hit your Family Savings balance limit, you can transfer cash from your Checking Account at any time from the BuckMe app on your phone.

According to recent reports, I should note here that the Family Savings app is a shared account between Jason and Lucia, and both characters can invest their money into this pool to hit five different savings goals. The thing with Family Savings is that once money has been transferred in, it can never be transferred out. The more you invest, however, the higher interest return you receive when the balance limit increases.

In a statement posted yesterday, Killing Floor developers Tripwire Interactive have declared that the studio is laying off 36 "talented" internal staff as part of a "workforce reduction". The job cuts come 16 months after the release of Killing Floor 3 (which James didn't care for), and within hours of unrelated yet equally dispiriting redunancies at Skydance Games.

Tripwire's announcement claims that this was "not an easy decision, but unfortunately a necessary one for the organisation," adding that "these are truly great people who are exceptional at their roles, and we will help support these individuals with compassion and dignity during this transition." There's a small hope in me that this might mean helping those affected find fresh jobs promptly, though it's hard to stay optimistic when mass layoffs in games development have become such a regular occurrence.

Despite this post primarily being about the loss of 36 livelihoods, Tripwire are quick to reassure fans that Killing Floor 3's post-launch updates remain in active development, as does their comedy shark-action sequel Maneater 2. The studio "remain committed to our awesome community", they say; apparently just not to their awesome employees.

This news also arrives just days after Tripwire expanded its publishing business to support small indie developers, and less than a year after its last round of layoffs in March. Tripwire also happens to have been acquired by layoff extraordinaire corporation Embracer in 2022, just for some relevant context.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It seems like we’re getting one of these every few months, but the world of mobile action RPGs that look like the games that, just a few years back, were only possible on consoles is expanding with another newly introduced entry.

Netmarble, a studio and publisher known for its free-to-play games on mobile and PC, recently unveiled the launch date for The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin, its next major release that’s very much coming for the Genshin Impact crowd.

In a recent development, the Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG based on the world of The Seven Deadly Sins anime and manga. The game takes place in the world of Britannia, which looks similar to the way it does in the anime.

That said, the story of the game is not based on the anime or manga, Instead, it’s an original story set in the universe of the show. You play as Prince Tristan of the Kingdom of Liones who must find a way to bring order back to Britannia.

The gameplay should be familiar to anyone who played a free-to-play action RPG in the last decade. It features action combat, a roster of diverse heroes that you assemble to form teams, and a large pretty world to explore where you’ll also get to meet new characters.

Speaking of which, while Origin has its own original story, expect to be teaming up with characters from the series - some of whom wouldn't be able to meet naturally. You can thank the game's multiversal story for that.

Beyond all the serious business of saving the world and battling monsters, The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin also has a cozy, relaxing side. You’ll be able to fish, cook, forage and take on the beauty of the world with your pals.

The game has a bit of an unusual release schedule. It’s set to arrive on PC, PS5, iOS, and Android. PC (Steam), and PS5 players will be able to jump in starting March 16, whereas the global mobile launch is scheduled for one week later, on March 23.

In a recent development, you can pre-register right now on the official website if you’re interested in earning a few rewards when the game launches. You can, of course, always wishlist the game on Steam and the PlayStation Store, too.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Yesterday, a rumor emerged on X claiming that Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra, the upcoming World War II-era superhero game led by Uncharted creator Amy Hennig, was being cancelled. After making the rounds on social media, new reports claim this is not the case, at least for now.

The rumor stemmed from a now-deleted X post from a fan account called Marvel 1943 Rise Of Hydra Countdown claiming, through supposed inside sources, that Skydance was preparing to announce the game’s cancellation. This rumor was quickly picked up and circulated by online gaming circles, gaining steam due to growing uncertainty around the game’s status.

Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra was revealed in 2022 and stars Captain America and Black Panther (Azurri, T'Challa's grandfather), alongside Howling Commandos member Gabriel Jones and Wakandan Spy Network leader Nanali, as they battle Hydra during World War II. Developed by Skydance Newly introduced Media, led by Amy Hennig, it’s been repeatedly delayed, and only cinematic footage has been released. This has understandably caused many to question the game’s fate.

In a recent development, however, a few hours after the cancellation rumor made the rounds, Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier reported on Bluesky that Skydance’s leadership addressed the rumor with the development team on Slack and assured them Marvel 1943 was not canceled. However, Schreier adds this could change due to the uncertainty caused by the recent merger between Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Skydance (Skydance Latest Media is a game development branch of the now-merged Skydance Corporation).

Skydance Games told the development team behind Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra on Slack this afternoon that the game is not canceled, despite a widely circulated rumor on Twitter today claiming that it was.

According to recent reports, furthermore, Kotaku’s Rebekah Valentine clarified in her report that Marvel 1943 executive producer Lu Giglotti told staff in a Skydance Slack message he’d spoken directly with the executive leadership team to confirm Marvel 1943 is still alive, saying, "There is no truth to these claims." According to Kotaku’s report, Giglotti informed the team that Marvel 1943 was approaching an Alpha milestone later this month. Giglotti also told staff not to let the rumor distract them and that Skydance was "monitoring the situation" to address in the future.

Sources indicate that kotaku’s report also sheds light on the game’s tumultuous development cycle. Marvel 1943 was originally pitched as a Netflix game before it was eventually turned into a console and PC title. This transition means the current iteration is “light on gameplay” and lacks substantial interactions, with players primarily using a single button to play it.

This isn't a completely surprising revelation, as Marvel 1943 was billed as a narrative-driven, linear single-player experience when it was revealed, but the style of game has never been clear. The same reveal also saw Skydance promise the game boasted "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-fresh globe-trotting adventure." This disconnect may be attributed to Kotaku also reporting that Marvel 1943 is “well over budget,” and its overall scope has been heavily scaled back. Regardless, the outlet’s source claims the game is “close to done.”.

Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra was initially slated to launch in 2025. It was then delayed to early 2026 "to add more polish", according to Skydance, before being pushed again to an undetermined launch window. The game has no declared platforms.

Although Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra appears safe for now, other recent projects have not been as fortunate. Be sure to read our stories about the recent high-profile cancellations of Gang of Dragon and Fairgames.

[Sources: Jason Schreier, Kotaku].

Breaking: GTA 6: How to Steal a Tank

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (482 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Dualshockers

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that there is no shortage of vehicles in Grand Theft Auto 6, something that’s made very apparent with the huge catalog listed under the progress bar in the menu.
  • Recent findings suggest that finding a tank isn’t like finding a pickup truck or a motorcycle.
  • In a recent development, cops are more aggressive, and you’ll have a lot of helicopters on your tail, but tanks are a special breed that are hidden away.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that there is no shortage of vehicles in Grand Theft Auto 6, something that’s made very apparent with the huge catalog listed under the progress bar in the menu. You’ll be stealing various types of cars, from high-end supercars to more ragged vehicles held together with duct tape. With that said, one popular vehicle makes it return: the tank. This behemoth of a wrecking ball can destroy anything in its path, but where to find one can be a bit tricky. Thankfully, this guide will show you exactly where to find them.

Recent findings suggest that finding a tank isn’t like finding a pickup truck or a motorcycle. A tank is a military grade vehicle, and considering Vice City isn’t some military compound, you won’t just drive by one. And after the years, even getting a five-star Wanted level, you won’t see them coming after you anymore.

In a recent development, cops are more aggressive, and you’ll have a lot of helicopters on your tail, but tanks are a special breed that are hidden away. In fact, they are somewhat hidden under your nose. That is because you are technically able to find and take control of a tank almost immediately in the campaign.

According to recent reports, you start the campaign south of Vice City in Key Lento, and you likely won’t think about what’s to the south. This is because it’s not only obscured in darkness, but the game does a good job pointing you north with Lucia and the prospect of the big city.

Well, as you can imagine, tanks are located in the south. If you have that long road across a couple of bridges, you’ll eventually come across the Mile Zero Air Station next to the Southwind community. Here, you’ll need to break in to find a tank.

You’ll want to enter from either the southeast or east entrance, preferably the former. The tanks are all nicely parked in the back, behind the southern hanger all the way to the western part of the base.

Pick one and get rolling, as you’ll likely have to avoid a five-star rating.

Now that you have a tank, the substantial question is: can you actually escape with it? Sadly, while you won’t immediately get a 6-star Wanted rating, it’s likely you will get one after a short while. This is because tanks have high firepower and can destroy anything outside of other armored vehicles with a single shot.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Grand Theft Auto 6’s marketing has been surreal, but nothing veered into the uncanny valley quite like the recent Only in Dade social media post.

A vertically filmed in-universe shot peering from the back seat of a car at an Invetero Coquette and police cruiser outside a Vice City hotel—the clip swerves into a level of realism that makes Rockstar’s newest game feel more like parking into a simulation than grabbing a controller. It’s no small wonder it’s the highest-rated game of all-time. Everyone has been fawning over the lifelike character models and gorgeous environments for years now, bewildered at side-by-sides with the real Miami, but they’re sleeping on just how far we’ve come from the low-poly, boxy cars of Liberty City and their blurred headlights.

Recent findings suggest that “You can tell what it is, but it isn’t what it is,” Beverly Hills Car Club co-owner Alex Manos says. “It’s almost like a reality TV show—a movie you’re a part of. It’s amazing.”.

It has been revealed that beverly Hills Car Club is one of the largest luxury car dealerships in the world, specializing in vintage cars, with their automobiles even appearing in films like the criminally underrated Birds of Prey. Founded by Alex and his mother, Versa Manos, in 2009, the pair quickly scaled from transforming beaters on the east side of Los Angeles into an impressive showroom attracting international celebrity buyers like Snoop Dogg, Rick Ross, and Tyler, The Creator.

Manos wasn’t interested in gushing about the dealership’s history when we jumped on a call, though. Immediately, he launched into a bout of excitement about Rockstar’s “revolutionary game” and how it’s almost “like a reality TV show” where players get to live out the life of its stars. “It’s so real,” Manos states. His focus is, naturally, on the cars.

In a recent development, “It’s not just about recreating the shape of a vehicle,” he explains. “It’s the stance, the proportions, the headlights, the body lines, and the little design details that give a car its character. As someone who has spent years buying and selling classic cars, I can tell you that sometimes the smallest details are what make a car special. Rockstar seems to understand that. They’ve managed to capture the spirit of some very recognizable automotive designs without simply copying them.”.

Throughout the interview, Manos would periodically pause to rifle through a stack of notes, pointing to cars that had appeared in trailers and screenshots, telling me about their real-life counterparts and how much attention to detail Rockstar had paid to every single curve, crease, and stitch of their designs.

Take the Ferrari Testarossa—i.e. the Grotti Cheetah—a staple of Vice City that we’ve already spent countless hours tearing down the beach and blurring palm trees with. Returning in GTA 6, it’s even more impressive than its ‘00s counterpart. “This one stood out to me right away,” Manos said. “The Testarossa is such an iconic 1980s car, especially when you think of Miami Vice. They did a good job capturing the wide rear end and the side vents. One thing people might not know is that those side vents on the original Ferrari actually helped direct air to the radiators. They weren't just there for looks.”.

According to recent reports, manos’ notes, which he shared with TheGamer, point to the “long hood” of the Albany Manana, drawing from its Cadillac Eldorado roots, or the “low roofline” of the Albany Buccaneer–based on the Buick Riviera. Cars like the Pegassi Tempesta (the Lamborghini Huracán) even draw on real anecdotes, as the Leonida police cruise around in these lavish sports cars just like the Italian police do for urgent medical transport. That’s not to mention the Progem Emerus, which comes “pretty close” to the McLaren Senna with its “large rear wing and aggressive bodywork,” or the Invetero Coquette, which captures the essence of the Corvette C8 despite “the shorter front end and wider rear.”.

It has been revealed that side vents, front nose droops, low rooflines—the smallest details that evoke these iconic cars are painstakingly recreated while giving everything a Leonidan spin, with Rockstar even turning a ‘60s Ford Mustang into an off-road buggy. But more than bodywork, cars speak to our identity. Just like the paradoxically Hawaiian shirts of Tommy Vercetti and Ricardo Diaz, or the animal-print boots Lucia wears, the cars in GTA 6 embody the game’s Floridian roots effortlessly.

It has been revealed that “Los Angeles and Miami have two very different car cultures,” Manos states. “I think the classic cars you see in each city really reflect their personalities. In Los Angeles, you have a deep appreciation for classic Porches, especially the air-cooled 911s, vintage Mercedes-Benz SLs, and, of course, American classics like the 1960s Lincoln Continental and Chevrolet Impala. Lowrider culture is also a huge part of LA's automotive identity, particularly the classic Impalas you see cruising around the city.

The cars definitely emulate that Miami, Florida vibe—more so than ever.

Recent findings suggest that “Miami has a completely different flavor. When I think of Miami, I immediately picture a white Ferrari Testarossa, a Lamborghini Countach, or a classic Ferrari 308 GTS. There's something about those bold Italian designs, the palm trees, the Art Deco architecture, and the ocean that just works. Miami has always had that glamorous, colorful 1980s image. What's interesting is that both cities have incredible car cultures, but Los Angeles feels more connected to automotive history and customization, while Miami has that flashy, exotic, tropical personality.”.

In a recent development, rockstar isn’t just packing the narrow roads of Vice City with expensive cars. It’s using its vehicles to communicate something about the place they’re driven, drawing from the rich history of Floridian cinema and its garish ‘80s aesthetic that it refuses to loosen its grip on.

In a recent development, games, just like movies, really shape what kind of cars you obsess over well into adulthood. The old black-and-white muscle cars you’d careen into oncoming traffic to cause historic pile-ups in Burnout 3: Takedown were formative in my adoration for Mustangs and Chevrolets, an obsession only strengthened by Driver: San Francisco—and Manos believes that an entirely new generation might be equally inspired by the cars of GTA 6, inciting a newfound appreciation for the classics.

Industry observers note that “It’s incredible that a video game can introduce a whole newly introduced generation to classic cars,” Manos notes. “For some people, GTA 6 might be the beginning of a lifelong passion for automobiles.

According to recent reports, “I think it’s inspiring—I think this is amazing for the car culture,” he continues. “This is where we are in the world, and I noted this to someone the other day that the classic car culture today has more people interested than ever before because of social media, because of the internet, because of GTA 6. It’s increasing people’s inspiration and people get to play this game, let’s say they drive the Albany Buccaneer, and they like it in the game, and they will aspire to have that in real life. If they can. Sometimes goals in life too–you don’t always have to achieve them. But it’s a goal that can get you to something. So this is a blessing for the car culture.”.

Industry observers note that manos even muses how people who are ingratiated with these cars may strive not only to get one for themselves, but modify and mold them to look identical to their Leonida counterparts. “Who knows if people are going to gravitate towards these more,” he claims. “How cool would that be—to have that same car and recreate it?”.

Of course, most GTA 6 players won’t be able to afford lavish sports cars, but as Manos notes, the sheer attention to detail that Rockstar has taken to recreating these Floridian cars with a Vice City lick of paint means that you can “experience the lifestyle without dishing out a million dollars.”.

To hear someone who has sold lavish cars to Ricky Ross and had his automobiles appear in DC blockbusters gush this much over GTA 6 really puts into perspective what a cultural juggernaut the game already is, and how everything—from the character models to the bird watching to the alligator-infested swamps to the vents on a car—has been treated with care.

“Rockstar has made it so authentic from the sound, the noise, the look, to the aesthetics,” Manos concludes. “They've done their best job to emulate the real thing. More so than ever before, because it just embodies you in the game. You know, that's why I think they've paid so much attention to the details, and got the best people to do it, because you get to really jump in, literally into the car and into the game and into the whole life of this experience.”.

Recent findings suggest that things are officially looking better for Marathon. The game’s Server Slam, essentially an open beta that’s freely available everywhere, has kicked off. This is the last chance for anyone curious about Bungie’s next big game to play it before it officially goes on sale next week.

Considering how unpopular the game has been throughout its development, and judging by the feedback from earlier closed beta tests, the turnout for the Server Slam is definitely encouraging.

Sources indicate that the Marathon Server Slam has been online for a little over 12 hours on Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. Only one of those platforms shares player numbers, of course, but it's enough to offer some visibility into how popular the test has been.

Sources indicate that immediately after servers went live, Marathon shot up the Steam most played charts. The game rapidly achieved a peak of 143,621 concurrent players (via SteamDB), which is very respectable. Given that the Server Slam will be available for the entire weekend, there’s every chance the numbers will go up.

These figures are particularly encouraging when you look at Arc Raiders, the current top dog in the extraction shooter space, and the game that stole Marathon’s thunder last year when the two of them were being promoted by their publishers. Marathon, of course, got delayed out of 2025, which allowed Arc Raiders to launch first. It, of course, ended up proving that extraction shooters can be mainstream hits.

Like Marathon, Arc Raiders hosted its own server slam just a few days before its launch. That open test attracted 189,668 concurrent players at its peak, which is not that far off from Marathon’s so far.

Assuming positive word of mouth continues, more players are bound to jump in over the weekend and perhaps get Marathon to match or even exceed Arc Raiders’ record. At any rate, this is good news for beleaguered Bungie and points to what could be a significant launch.

Marathon arrives March 5 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In what has come to feel like the dawn of the final day before Grand Theft Auto VI's release, one thing that Rockstar really don't want people to be aware of is the ongoing legal dispute between the Rockstar Games Workers Union and the studio itself following Rockstar's alleged union busting in firing 31 union members last year. Starting on the 12th through to the 26th, recognition of the union will be voted upon by staff to ensure that workers would be given a say over "topics including pay and bonuses, overtime, redundancies, flexible working arrangements, and generative AI policies.".

Recent findings suggest that if it passes, the vote would also make the union the largest recognised union in the UK games industry, partly thanks to its partnership with the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain. Now, the global labor union SAG-AFTRA have chimed in to endorse the Workers Union, offering solidarity to the members involved and granting crucial leverage from a global force.

SAG-AFTRA's statement declares that "unionisation is vital for the future of the video game industry", and that "in the face of record layoffs, job instability, hostile work places, and toxic crunch culture, it is now more critical than ever for unions and workers to stand in support of one another." They advocate for fair treatment, especially in the wake of displacement due to corporate mismanagement and genAI, and proudly state that "this is a fight for all workers.".

Their statement closes by saying that "the gaming industry is a commercial juggernaut, and the people that create these amazing works of art deserve fair treatment and the opportunity to improve the terms of their employment with a strong voice at the bargaining table. We honor the courage of our fellow game workers at Rockstar and proudly support their union vote.".

In a recent development, solidarity with the workers, always. We can only wait and see how the voting process pans out.

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
